notes.title: Cube Escape Collection - Release date + Trailer
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33593611/7840c5679b78faccf1deb65fa216558498b198a9.jpg[/img]

Finally! The Cube Escape Collection will be released on October 14th on Steam!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R6RUyC-w9Lk

Follow the path of Dale, Laura and other Rusty lake characters like Mr. Crow and Mr. Owl in this classic point-and-click adventure anthology! The nine Cube Escape games are updated (achievements / hints / translations), preserved and bundled to survive the end of the Flash Games era.

Thanks for your support 🖤

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection

Art by Sevenix!
